home.faqA1: NutURL is an all-in-one suite for creators, affiliates, and companies. We combine a bio link page builder (Linktree alternative), a URL shortener with a dedicated short domain (wnet.me), and a social media video downloader under a single unified dashboard.
home.faqQ2: Is the wnet.me domain safe? Who operates it?
home.faqA2: Yes, wnet.me is the official short domain operated exclusively by the NutURL platform (nuturl.com). We use an ultra-short 7-character domain so your links take less space and get higher CTR on WhatsApp, SMS, and social media.
home.faqA3: Yes! You can create your bio page, shorten links using wnet.me, and download media for free. We also offer advanced plans for users looking for granular analytics and extra branding options.
home.faqQ4: How can I verify where a wnet.me link points before clicking?
home.faqA4: Simply add a plus sign '+' at the end of any short link (e.g. wnet.me/code+) or use our verification tool to preview the destination URL safely.
